_about: Rates for equity cash-market trades. Percent values are percent of turnover (qty x price). Every block says where it came from. page_checked is the date the rate was read from the broker's own page; verified stays false until a real contract note is reproduced to the paisa by a test.

statutory._source: Statutory, same at every broker: STT (Finance Act), stamp duty (Indian Stamp Act, 2020 uniform rates), SEBI turnover fee. Read directly from https://zerodha.com/charges on 2026-10-27.

exchange_txn_pct._source: Exchange transaction charges as Zerodha passes them through, read directly from https://zerodha.com/charges on 2026-10-27 (NSE 0.00307%, BSE 0.00375%, equity delivery and intraday).

zerodha._source: https://zerodha.com/charges, read directly 2026-10-27: delivery brokerage zero; intraday 0.03% or Rs 20 per executed order, whichever is lower; DP Rs 15.34 per scrip on the sell day (Rs 3.5 CDSL + Rs 9.5 Zerodha + Rs 2.34 GST), irrespective of quantity. Female first holders get Rs 0.25 off the CDSL fee (not modelled).
